description:
A few extra console commands. Presently includes the following:

-

AnnexFaction

: Takes the all of the colonies from the first faction and gives them to the second faction.

-

AnnexSystem

: Give a target system, an annexing faction, and an optional victim faction to transfer ownership of all colonies to the annexing faction. Specifying a victim faction restricts the targeted colonies to theirs.

-

CleanseSystem

: Applies the Destroy, Deciv, or Wipe effects from DestroyFaction to all colonies in a specified system. Indiscriminate targeting for now.

-

DestroyFaction

: Simply speaking, the DestroyColony command applied to all of a given faction's markets. Supports optional arguments Deciv and Wipe: former should be obvious, latter removes the ruin conditions left behind after destroying a colony. Similar to DestroyColony there are no checks for story essential planets. Use judiciously.

-

FindBPs

: A command that produces a list of blueprint packages sorted by which ones you have and haven't learned.

-

FindFactionBPs

: Displays a list of ships/wings/weapons that the specified faction knows.

-

FindHullmods

: Produces a list of unlearned hullmods.

-

FindRareBPs

: Displays a list of rare blueprints the player hasn't learned (blueprints that drop individually) sorted by category.

-

FindUniqueBPs

: Displays a list of items that can drop as individual blueprints and are not known by any faction.

-

FindUniqueItems

: Displays a list of ships/wings/weapons that are not known by any faction, regardless of the items' potential inclusion within a blueprint. (e.g. Zigg, XIV Legion, etc.)

-

GetShipID

: Gets the id of the specified ship.

-

ShipEfficiency

: Provides a list of the most efficient ships in certain categories. e.g. ships with the most favorable cargo capacity to monthly supply ratio.

-

accAllHullmods

: By default: adds all vanilla hullmods that aren’t hidden or ‘codex unlockable’, Optional arguments to get hullmods from Mods and to obtain the ‘codex unlockable’ mods as well.

-

AllCodexShips

: Adds all codex visible ships to storage. This includes ships whose codex entries have not been unlocked.

-

AllColonyItems

: Adds all colony items to 'storage'.

-

AllFactionItems

: Adds all of the known weapons and wings of the specified faction to 'storage'.

-

AllFactionShips

: Adds all of the known ships of the specified faction to 'storage'.

-

AllModItems

: Adds all weapons and wings from the specified mod to Storage.

-

AllModShips

: Adds all ships from the specified mod to Storage.

-

ClearStorage

: Removes

all

items and ships from 'storage'.

-

AddSkill, RemoveSkill, ViewSkills

which let you add or remove individual skills to/from yourself, your officers, or your admins; and view all skills that your character currently has.

-

AddPermaMod

: Adds a perma mod to either a specified ship or all of the ships in your fleet. A third, optional argument 'smod' causes this perma-mod to be smodded.

-

RemoveHullMod

: Removes a hullmod from either a specified ship or all of the ships in your fleet.

-

accFactions

: Displays a sorted list of factions. Factions with markets, factions that are visible on the intel screen without markets, and hidden marketless factions that know at least 1 ship blueprint - a requirement intended to filter out irrelevant factions. Having nexerelin enabled will further truncate the 3rd category.

-

FactionDoctrine

: Displays the doctrine of the specified faction.

-

FindColonyItems

: Finds all

installed

colony items throughout the sector.

-

SetContactRelation

: Set the player’s relationship with the named contact (or all of them) to a specified amount.

-

AddPermaMember

: Adds a permanent member to the specified alliance. If the second argument (faction) is left empty, then all current alliance members will become permanent.

-

RemovePermaMember

: Removes the specified faction from permanent membership in their faction. This does not remove them from the alliance altogether.

-

SolidifyAlliance

: Sets the relationships of all factions with the specified alliance to a minimum between 50-100.

-

AddEntity

: Adds an entity (stable locations, nav buoys, etc.) on the player's location, which either orbits the nearest star, or a specified object within the system.

-

FindSalvageLocations

: Prints a list of systems that contain Orbital Habitats, and Mining and Research Stations.

-

SpawnAbyssEncounter

: Spawns a specified Abyssal hyperspace encounter. Must use in the Abyss itself.

-

SurveySalvageSystems

: Fully surveys all planets in systems that contain Orbital Habitats, and Mining and Research Stations.

-

ColonizePlanet

: The specified faction will instantly form a colony of a specified size (or 3 if no second argument is provided) at either a specified planet, or a semi-random one if no third argument is provided.

-

SpawnColonyFleet

: Spawns a colony expedition from the specified faction to either a specified planet, or a semi-random one if no second argument is provided.

-

ExposeHiddenTooltips

: Will remove the ‘limited_tooltip_if_locked’ tag from all ships. Does not persist through game restarts.

-

UnlockSimVariants

: Unlocks all factions and ship variants for use in the simulator.

-

accFastBuild

: Runs the command ‘FastBuild’ while also undisrupting all industries.

-

DisruptIndustry

: Disrupts the specified industry for X amount of days.

-

SetEventProgress

: Sets the specified event’s progress to a specific amount.

-

ToggleTeleport

: Upon activation, pressing CTRL + LMB will teleport the player's fleet to their mouse location.

Use "help acc" to see all of the commands my mod adds.

Requires

Console Commands

.

Download Additional Console Commands
